thread.title: Amazon Drops 5%, And Twitter Is Your Safe Port

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Amazon Drops 5%, And Twitter Is Your Safe Port
text:
When markets fell out of bed yesterday, FAANG names traded mixed, wth Facebook ( FB ) and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) and Apple ( AAPL ) faring better than Amazon ( AMZN ) and Netflix ( NFLX ).
That trend continues today, with the Nasdaq Composite down 1.7%, as Facebook and Alphabet and Apple are holding up better than their brethren.
Facebook is off $1.14, or 0.7%, at $at $170.44, and is turning around. Alphabet is actually in the green, up $2.41, at $1,010.12. Apple is down $1.20, or 0.8%, at $153.32.
Amazon is down $63.60, or almost 5%, at $1,286.90, and Netflix is down $10.58, or 4%, at $239.52.
Interestingly, this week's earnings darlings, Twitter ( TWTR ) and Snap (SNAP) are holding up well. Twitter is up 66 cents or 2%, at $30.84, and Snap ( SNAP ) is down 71 cents, or 3.7%, at $18.68.
